items.name: Cloak of the Relief
items.lore: Marsh-brown, with the Vigil's white tower. Given to those who relieved the Vigil.

items.name: Vigil Tower Ring
items.lore: The white tower in grey stone.

items.name: Drowned Plate Bracer
items.lore: Cut from the Vigil's armour, scoured clean.

items.name: Marsh Warden's Torc
items.lore: Bog-iron, twisted by the Wardens' smith.

items.name: Vrask's Gorget
items.lore: Won from Ghoul-Marshal Vrask. Still damp inside.

items.name: Lord-Commander's Seal
items.lore: Won from the Drowned Lord-Commander when the keep held.

draughts: From Caer Witrin's orchards. Sharp and sweet.
Bitter. Brec swears it clears the head.
Caer Witrin's best. Everything comes back faster after a cup.
